when.description: One property selector (device, endpoint, cluster, property) or named inputs. A raw clock input is {name:'clock',clock:'minute'}. A visual clock can specify at (local minute 0..1439) or start/end (same-day window), and weekdays (unique days 1..7, Monday first). Visual property tests also specify type and op.

conditions.description: All must hold at trigger time. A clock condition uses clock:minute, optional weekdays and a window; it does not wake the rule.

action.description: One step or an ordered sequence: Matter (device, endpoint, cluster, name, arguments), local (native, arguments; see fabric://automation/actions), or delay (delay_s: 1..86400).
